subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw expose a global/per-agent hard iteration budget, and which counting and exhaustion semantics should become the public contract?
rationale: The need is well supported, but choosing the durable config shape and terminal behavior affects agent-core semantics, nested runs, channel delivery, provider compatibility, and future upgrades.

options.title: Sponsor a canonical budget
options.body: Define one count model and deterministic exhaustion outcome, then repair and prove https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485 against that contract.

options.title: Retain pattern guards only
options.body: Decline the new config surface and document loop detection, stuck-session aborts, and provider switching as the supported mitigations.

options.title: Defer implementation
options.body: Keep this canonical issue open while closing or pausing the linked PR until maintainers are ready to choose the public semantics.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a canonical budget
recommendation.body: Define one count model and deterministic exhaustion outcome, then repair and prove https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485 against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the prior canonical-routing review and is the strongest available decision-routing signal for the cross-cutting agent/config contract.
